info.title: API.SH: TipRanks
info.description: The TipRanks API from API.SH: public TipRanks data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

A Wall Street analyst's profile: firm, sector, rank among all analysts, success rate, average return, rating distribution, best rating, and every stock they cover with their latest rating and price target.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tipranks-analyst

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Fund or manager slug from the profile URL, e.g. `warren-buffett`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One investor's public portfolio on TipRanks: display name, description and stated risk, rank, star rating, success rate, returns (1 month to since added, YTD, Sharpe), best trade, monthly returns with the average and best-performer benchmark, every holding (ticker, name, type, weight, date added, average price, last close, market cap, beta, P/E, EPS, dividend, 52-week range), asset allocation, sector distribution and recent activity. `include_chart=true` adds the daily cumulative return against the S&P 500.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tipranks-investor

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Portfolio id from `/tipranks/v1/top-investors` (or the investor's tipranks.com/experts/investors/... URL).

parameters.name: include_chart
parameters.description: true adds `daily_performance` (date, cumulative return, S&P 500 cumulative return).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
